settings.name_in_paper: Decentralized multi-player Bernoulli bandit with sensing (observation models I and II)
unmapped: N = M players (M <= K) act in a decentralized way without communication; colliding players get reward 0
each player observes the sensing information Y_{A^j(t),t} and (fully or partially) the collision indicator
regret is the system regret against the oracle assigning the M players to the M best arms
strict gap mu_M^* > mu_{M+1}^* (instance in P_M)
settings.definition_quote: In the multi-player MAB setting, there are $M \in \{1,\dots,K\}$ players ... Each player $j$ then receives (and observes) the binary rewards $r^j(t) := Y_{A^j(t),t} \indic(\overline{C^j(t)})$. ... R_T(\mu, M, \rho) := (\sum_{k=1}^{M}\mu_k^*)T - E_{\mu}[\sum_{t=1}^T\sum_{j=1}^M r^j(t)].

source.label: thm:BetterLowerBound
source.quote: Under observation models I and II, for any strongly uniformly efficient decentralized policy $\rho$ and $\boldsymbol{\mu}\in\cP_M$, \forall j, \forall k \in \Mworst, \liminf_{T\to \infty} \frac{\E_{\mu}[T_k^j(T)]}{\log(T)} \geq \frac{1}{\kl(\mu_k, \mu_M^*)}.

results.notes: Lower bound on per-player number of draws of a sub-optimal arm.

symbols.Delta_iM: mu_M^* - mu_i for arm i among the K-M worst arms

conditions: sum_subopt ranges over the K-M worst arms (M-worst set)
N is the number of players M

source.label: thm:BetterLowerBound
source.quote: From Lemma~\ref{lem:1stLowerBound}, it follows that \liminf_{T \to +\infty} \frac{R_T(\boldsymbol{\mu}, M, \rho)}{\log(T)} \geq M \times \left( \sum_{k \in \Mworst} \frac{(\mu_M^* -  \mu_k)}{\kl(\mu_k, \mu_M^*)} \right).

results.notes: Regret is system regret defined via expected rewards against oracle on M best arms; equals pseudo-regret form.

symbols.kl_kM: kl(mu_k, mu_M^*) for sub-optimal arm k

conditions: bound on E[T_k^j(T)] for any M-worst arm k and any player j
tuning: exploration function f(t) = log(t) + 3 log log(t)

source.label: lem:SubOptimalSelections
source.quote: For any $\boldsymbol{\mu}\in\cP_M$, if player $j$ uses the RandTopM-, MCTopM- or rhoRand-klUCB decentralized policy with exploration function $f(t) = \log(t) + 3 \log\log(t)$, then for any sub-optimal arm $k \in \Mworst$, there exists two problem depend constants ... \E_{\mu}[T_k^j(T)] \leq \frac{\log(T)}{\kl(\mu_k,\mu_{M}^*)}+ C \sqrt{\log(T)} + D\log\log(T) + 3M + 1.

results.notes: Same lemma covers RandTopM and rhoRand (r4, r5). Matches lower bound r1 asymptotically.

conditions: bound on the expected total number of colliding players over all arms

source.label: lem:collisionsMCTopM
source.quote: For any $\boldsymbol{\mu}\in\cP_M$, if all players use the MCTopM-klUCB decentralized policy, and $M \leq K$, then the total average number of collisions (on all arms) is upper-bounded by \E_{\mu}[\sum_{k=1}^K \cC_k(T)] \leq M^2(2 M + 1) (\sum_{a,b,\;\mu_a < \mu_b} \frac{1}{\kl(\mu_a,\mu_b)}) \log(T) + o(\log T).

results.notes: Stated as leading term + o(log T); recorded as limsup. Also implies logarithmic number of arm switches.

symbols.G_M_mu: problem-dependent constant depending on mu and M (from Lemmas 8, 10)

tuning: exploration function f(t) = log(t) + 3 log log(t)

source.label: thm:LogarithmicRegret_MCTopMklUCB
source.quote: If all $M$ players use MCTopM-klUCB, and $M \leq K$, then for any problem $\boldsymbol{\mu} \in \cP_M$, there exists a problem dependent constant $G_{M,\boldsymbol{\mu}}$, such that the regret satisfies: R_T(\boldsymbol{\mu}, M, \rho) \leq G_{M,\boldsymbol{\mu}} \log(T) + o(\log T).

results.notes: Constant G not explicit in the statement; recorded as limsup R_T/log T <= G.
